teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions on loops and debugging, and answered student questions during office hours.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric as part of assigned teaching assistant activities.

projects.title: Quiz Practice Tool
bullets: Implemented a small command-line quiz practice tool in Python using functions and collections for an individual course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git during the project.
